video_title: Zach Edey Walk-Off Interview | Grizzlies vs. Wizards

quotes.speaker: Zach Edey
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Edey on Memphis Grizzlies' second-half turnaround against Wizards
quotes.excerpt: we cleaned it up as a team and we came out and performed great in that second half.

text_blocks.speaker: Rob Fischer
text_blocks.text: That first half, it seemed like you guys really had trouble finding a rhythm on both sides of the ball. You took over the game in the third quarter, what changed?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Edey
text_blocks.text: We just stayed with it. We were messing up in the basics a little bit, letting them get too many rebounds, letting them get to the free throw line a little bit. We cleaned it up as a team and we came out and performed great in that second half.

quotes.social_post: Zach Edey on the Grizzlies second half turnaround against the Wizards: We were messing up in the basics a little bit, letting them get too many rebounds. We cleaned it up as a team and we came out and performed great in that second half.

structured.context: Zach Edey reflects on the Memphis Grizzlies' second-half turnaround against the Washington Wizards after a slow start.

text_blocks.text: 42 assists tonight as a team. What does that say about this team?

text_blocks.text: Just kept the ball moving, kept it popping. Everybody was looking to make the right reads all night. It was great team basketball.

quotes.speaker: Zach Edey
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Edey on Grizzlies' team chemistry and shared work ethic
quotes.excerpt: Everybody plays so hard in this team that everybody wants to get each other involved.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Does it show a trust that you guys have in each other as well?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Edey
text_blocks.text: For sure. Everybody plays so hard in this team that everybody wants to get each other involved. Everybody sees the work we're putting in and just feeds off each other.

quotes.speaker: Zach Edey
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Edey on his offensive performance and team support
quotes.excerpt: I was just getting the ball in my spots tonight. My teammates were really looking for me.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: You had your biggest offensive night of the season. What was different tonight? What worked for you?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Edey
text_blocks.text: I was just getting the ball in my spots tonight. My teammates were really looking for me. We were short-handed, they understood the matchups and they got the ball to me. It felt great tonight.

quotes.social_post: Zach Edey on his season high offensive performance: I was just getting the ball in my spots tonight. My teammates were really looking for me. We were short handed, they understood the matchups and they got the ball to me.

structured.context: Zach Edey describes his season-high offensive performance and how his teammates helped him find his spots.

quotes.speaker: Zach Edey
quotes.summary_phrase: Zach Edey on the importance of paint scoring for Grizzlies
quotes.excerpt: That's where we're going to win or lose games. Possession battles, points in the paint, points in transition.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: 60 points in the paint in two straight games. How important is that number still for this team?

text_blocks.speaker: Zach Edey
text_blocks.text: It's huge. That's where we're going to win or lose games. Possession battles, points in the paint, points in transition. We need all those hustle points, we need all that extra boost, and tonight we got it.

quotes.social_post: Zach Edey on the importance of paint scoring: That is where we are going to win or lose games. Possession battles, points in the paint, points in transition. We need all those hustle points, we need all that extra boost.
